sourceBinding: Source-before and source-after SHA256 maps are identical; final integration commit binding is recorded separately by root.
capturedScope: All engine/lib Dart files, acceptance tool, retained DOCX fixture, engine/root manifests, root lockfile, root package configuration. This is not the complete transitive compiled-input closure.
independentSourceOracle: Hash-bound retained fixture requires all four original 0.5pt black sides before any conversion; logical start/end are not inferred from an already-deserialized snapshot.
verified: Original citation IDs, complete citation JSON including unknown fields, cached text, editable fields, field balance, table/cell ownership, document preferences, normalized paragraph text, side masks, common stroke color/width, padding, merged ownership and grid through two actual converter saves and four paired native DOCX/ODT cycles per case.
numericTolerance: Stroke width 0.000001 pt; other captured geometry at most 0.05 pt from the original expectation in every cycle. Metadata compares exactly. Paragraph text comparison trims boundary whitespace.

priorAttempts.converter/attempt-1: Diagnostic only. Weaker native-derived oracle missed pre-existing DOCX logical start/end loss; retained-cell pass is not accepted as original-visible-border preservation.
priorAttempts.converter/attempt-2: Genuine failure from strengthened independent retained source oracle. No captured inputs changed. Coloured-side and merged cases passed; retained DOCX logical edges were lost before export.

geometryEvidence: geometry/ contains controlled input variants, unmodified actual converter outputs, PDF measurements and source provenance. They refuted uniform four-side halfstroke compensation; implementation retains padding values. Geometry probes are separate from final functional counts.

initialSmokeAttempts.engine: runtime/engine-smoke.jsonl: 34 visible passing cases, harness readiness only; no source-stability closure captured, not included in final acceptance counts.
initialSmokeAttempts.flutter: runtime/flutter-smoke.jsonl and .stderr: compile failed because an active concurrent merge had conflict markers. Not a product/runtime qualification result. No subsequent Flutter run by this agent.

limits: Converter is LibreOfficeDev 26.8.0.0.alpha0, not stable-release qualification.
No installed Zotero-plugin session or Microsoft Word execution.
No unrestricted ODF compatibility or pixel-identical layout claim.
Three controlled table cases; the wider regression suites are recorded separately.
Border support remains collapsing single solid common RGB stroke, bounded exact eighth-point widths and uniform padding; mixed or unsupported structures remain refused.
The acceptance snapshot does not measure every font/style/layout property.
